name: pyguitest window control
description: Exposes window listing, geometry, move/resize, activate, minimize, per-window screen capture, and window create/close/title-change events over D-Bus at /org/gnome/Shell/Extensions/Pyguitest, for pyguitest's GnomeShellBackend. Not useful on its own -- it has no UI. See gnome-shell-extension/README.md in the pyguitest source tree.
